summary: Steady base flow of the lid-driven cavity at Re = 3600 by Newton-GMRES from the t = 100 DNS state.
description: Steady base flow of the lid-driven cavity by Newton-GMRES from the t = 100 DNS state of 000_dns (lx1 = 12). The seed is a fixed point to 4.3e-7 (squared L2 norm of the residual), and Newton needs 10 iterations and 117 Krylov vectors to reach the tolerance 1e-12. The tolerance applies to the squared norm, and the slowest mode decays at rate 0.0168 over the unit Newton time, so the field error is about sqrt(tol)/0.0167. At the tolerance 1e-9 the field stays 3e-3 from the steady state; at 1e-12 the seeds t = 100 and t = 600 give the same field to 8e-5.

newton_final_residual.note: Final Newton residual (column 7) must not exceed the Newton tolerance (column 8, 1e-12).

newton_first_residual.note: Residual of the t = 100 DNS seed.
